summary: A dice-worker-placement game where players race to build factories and complete contracts, rolling and locking dice to trigger card abilities in a light engine-building loop. It's often compared to Machi Koro or Orleans-lite in feel: quick to teach, snowbally, and driven by combo chains rather than deep strategy.
praised: fast-playing and easy to teach for the amount of engine building it offers
satisfying combo chains from cards interacting with dice workers
criticised: can feel swingy or snowbally once someone's engine gets going
art and production seen as budget compared to similar euros
some find the contract/scoring system fiddly to track

interaction.kind: shared market competition, mostly parallel play

scoring.why: points come from completed contracts, buildings, and bonus tags, rewarding the fastest, most synergistic factory engine
